project.name: realworld
project.notes: Trace-heavy set: 9 multi-hop questions (entry points reaching a method through interfaces, tests reaching a line several calls down, the impact of a signature change across layers, paths through Spring beans, stack traces), 2 one-hop controls and 2 text controls. Ground truth was built with grep and by reading the code, before any tool run.

questions.prompt: Which entry points reach the MyBatis mapper method `io.spring.infrastructure.mybatis.mapper.CommentMapper.insert` through some chain of calls? Count REST controller methods (in `io.spring.api`) and GraphQL resolver methods (in `io.spring.graphql`) that carry a request mapping or a DGS annotation. Count static call chains: calls through interfaces count, and a call counts whichever branch would run.
questions.notes: CommentMapper.insert <- MyBatisCommentRepository.save <- CommentRepository.save (interface) <- the two createComment methods.

questions.prompt: Which entry points reach the domain method `io.spring.core.user.User.update(String, String, String, String, String)` through some chain of calls? `io.spring.core.article.Article.update` is a different method. Count REST controller methods (in `io.spring.api`) and GraphQL resolver methods (in `io.spring.graphql`) that carry a request mapping or a DGS annotation. Count static call chains: calls through interfaces count, and a call counts whichever branch would run.
questions.notes: User.update <- UserService.updateUser <- the two entry points. Look-alike: Article.update under the article update entry points.

questions.prompt: Which entry points reach `io.spring.infrastructure.mybatis.readservice.UserRelationshipQueryService.isUserFollowing` through some chain of calls? `UserRelationshipQueryService.followingAuthors` is a different method. Count REST controller methods (in `io.spring.api`) and GraphQL resolver methods (in `io.spring.graphql`) that carry a request mapping or a DGS annotation. Count static call chains: calls through interfaces count, and a call counts whichever branch would run.
questions.notes: isUserFollowing <- ArticleQueryService.fillExtraInfo(String, User, ArticleData) <- findById/findBySlug; <- ProfileQueryService.findByUsername; <- CommentQueryService.findById. The list queries go through the other fillExtraInfo overload to followingAuthors (forbidden). ProfileDatafetcher has a public and a private queryProfile; DuplicatedArticleValidator.isValid reaches findBySlug but is no entry point.

questions.prompt: Trace the call chain from the GraphQL mutation `io.spring.graphql.UserMutation.updateUser` down to the MyBatis mapper method that writes the changed user row. List every method on that chain.
questions.answer_items: the methods on the chain as `Class.method`, in call order
questions.notes: Spring wiring: UserService gets the UserRepository bean, implemented by MyBatisUserRepository.

questions.prompt: Trace the call chain from the GraphQL query resolver `io.spring.graphql.ArticleDatafetcher.getFeed` to the MyBatis query `io.spring.infrastructure.mybatis.readservice.UserRelationshipQueryService.followingAuthors`. List every method on that chain.
questions.answer_items: the methods on the chain as `Class.method`, in call order
questions.notes: fillExtraInfo(List<ArticleData>, User) is the overload on the chain; the other overload calls isUserFollowing.

questions.prompt: Which JUnit test methods reach the line `articleMapper.insert(article)` in `io.spring.infrastructure.repository.MyBatisArticleRepository.createNew` (MyBatisArticleRepository.java:40) through some chain of calls? Count only calls in the test method's own body and what they call, not setup methods (`@BeforeEach`). Calls on a mock count, calls through interfaces count, and a call counts whichever branch would run.
questions.notes: insert <- createNew <- MyBatisArticleRepository.save <- ArticleRepository.save (interface) <- tests; and <- ArticleCommandService.createArticle/updateArticle <- calls on the mock in ArticlesApiTest and ArticleApiTest. ArticleQueryServiceTest.setUp saves an article, but setup methods don't count.

questions.prompt: If a parameter is added to the MyBatis read method `io.spring.infrastructure.mybatis.readservice.UserReadService.findByUsername(String)`, which Java methods under src/main call it directly and have to change, and which entry points are affected through any chain of calls? List both. `io.spring.core.user.UserRepository.findByUsername` and `UserMapper.findByUsername` are different methods. Count REST controller methods (in `io.spring.api`) and GraphQL resolver methods (in `io.spring.graphql`) that carry a request mapping or a DGS annotation. Count static call chains: calls through interfaces count, and a call counts whichever branch would run.
questions.notes: The only Java caller is ProfileQueryService.findByUsername; the entry points sit one or two levels above it (RelationMutation through buildProfile, ProfileDatafetcher through its private queryProfile).

questions.prompt: A production log shows an exception whose top frame is `at io.spring.application.CommentQueryService.findById(CommentQueryService.java:31)`. Which entry points call into the method of that frame through some chain of calls? Count REST controller methods (in `io.spring.api`) and GraphQL resolver methods (in `io.spring.graphql`) that carry a request mapping or a DGS annotation. Count static call chains: calls through interfaces count, and a call counts whichever branch would run.
questions.notes: Line 31 is the isUserFollowing call inside findById. Look-alikes: findByArticleId and findByArticleIdWithCursor.

questions.prompt: A production log shows an exception whose top frame is `at io.spring.application.ArticleQueryService.setIsFollowingAuthor(ArticleQueryService.java:135)`. Which entry points call into the method of that frame through some chain of calls? Count REST controller methods (in `io.spring.api`) and GraphQL resolver methods (in `io.spring.graphql`) that carry a request mapping or a DGS annotation. Count static call chains: calls through interfaces count, and a call counts whichever branch would run.
questions.notes: setIsFollowingAuthor <- fillExtraInfo(List<ArticleData>, User) <- findRecentArticles, findUserFeed and their WithCursor variants. The single-article queries use the other fillExtraInfo overload.

questions.prompt: Which production methods (under src/main) call `io.spring.core.service.AuthorizationService.canWriteArticle` directly? `canWriteComment` is a different method.
questions.notes: One-hop control. In ArticleApi the calls sit in lambdas; the enclosing methods count.

questions.prompt: Which production methods (under src/main) call the interface method `io.spring.core.service.JwtService.toToken(User)` directly?
questions.notes: One-hop control. DefaultJwtService.toToken implements it and does not call it.

questions.prompt: Where is the default profile image for new users configured, and which class reads that setting?
questions.answer_items: the configuration file name and the class name
questions.notes: Text control: image.default in src/main/resources/application.properties, read with @Value in UserService.

questions.prompt: The API answers "article name exists" when an article is created. Which annotation type declares that message, which validator class enforces it, and which field is it applied to?
questions.answer_items: the annotation type and the validator class as class names, and the field as `Class.field`
